agent: Instructions Generator

Take the information below and generate instructions [NAME].instructions.md file for it in the /.github/instructions/ directory. If a .md file name is provided, use that for the [NAME] placeholder, otherwise generate an appropriate filename based on generated content. Make sure that instructions are concise and not too long. If no information is provided, prompt the user to give the necessary details about the layer of architecture or coding standards to document.
The .md file should have a front matter header with a description of the instructions and an optional applyTo field that specifies which files the instructions apply to.
